Q144.cannot: The records do not contain the counterfactual outcomes of weighing every pallet at dispatch or scanning every case at the store. OTIF is measured from actual shipments, pick confirmations, and arrivals (shipments-june, dc-pick-confirmations-june). No table records what would happen under a new process, nor does any table link a weighing or case-scan intervention to changes in on-time arrival or case-level fill. Therefore, the improvement cannot be estimated from the data.
